title: Attestor CIS Rule
description: Schema for a single Attestor CIS benchmark control (rule YAML). MVP scope: Windows 11 Standalone + Ubuntu 22.04 Desktop, Level 1. See docs/rule-schema.md for field intent.

id.description: CIS control ID in dotted-number form, e.g. "1.1.1.1".

description.description: Optional. What the control checks and why (from the benchmark).

rationale.description: Optional. Security reasoning for the control.

benchmark.description: Name of the source CIS benchmark, e.g. "CIS Ubuntu Linux 22.04 LTS Benchmark".

benchmark_version.description: Version of the source benchmark, e.g. "v2.0.0".

profile.description: Applicable CIS profiles for this control.

automated.description: true if programmatically checkable; false => manual review only (checks may be empty).

severity.description: Severity for report prioritization (borrowed from ComplianceAsCode).

checks.description: Ordered list of checks; control passes only if ALL pass. May be empty only when automated is false.

type.description: Check dispatcher type. MVP targets only (Win11 Standalone + Ubuntu 22.04).

op.description: Comparison operator for the check (type-specific params carry the rest).

remediation.description: Actionable fix text shown in the report.

source.description: Traceable provenance: CIS benchmark section reference or "manual verification on <OS> <date>". Must not be empty or generic.
